name: Dynamic Negative Keyword Exclusion in E-Commerce Filters
description: A user searches 'monitor -curved' to find flat computer monitors. The engine must extract positive search terms and suppress any record containing the negative terms.
prompt:
A user searches 'monitor -curved' to find flat computer monitors. The engine must extract positive search terms and suppress any record containing the negative terms.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: item_id, title, description.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Positive term: 'monitor', Negative term: 'curved'
            SELECT 
                item_id,
                title,
                description
            FROM display_items
            WHERE (title ILIKE '%monitor%' OR description ILIKE '%monitor%')
              AND NOT (title ILIKE '%curved%' OR description ILIKE '%curved%')
            ORDER BY item_id;
why_it_fails: Negative keywords must not exclude items where the negative term appears with negation qualifiers (e.g. 'not curved').
